description: This Java class, MessagesModelFactory, is a utility factory class within the Eclipse Ditto project that provides static methods to create builders for message-related objects such as Message and MessageHeaders. It manages the creation and configuration of message headers and message builders, including handling deprecated methods for backward compatibility.

classes.name: MessagesModelFactory
classes.description: A final utility class providing static factory methods for message object creation within the Eclipse Ditto messaging model.

methods.name: newMessageBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new MessageBuilder for a Message with specified headers, allowing setting of message payload.

methods.name: newHeadersBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new MessageHeadersBuilder for constructing message headers, deprecated version accepting String-based thingId.

methods.name: newHeadersBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new MessageHeadersBuilder for constructing message headers with a typed ThingId instance.

methods.name: newHeadersBuilder
methods.description: Creates a MessageHeadersBuilder initialized with a map of initial headers.
